_help: Active transfer bonuses. bonus_pct 20 means 1,000 card points -> 1,200 partner points. Partner must match cards_data.py exactly. Expired entries are ignored automatically. Check roame.travel/guides/points-transfer-bonuses or awardtravelfinder.com/transfer-bonuses; Bilt runs Rent Day bonuses on the 1st of each month. A partner not in that pool's list in cards_data.py can never match, so it is a data error, not a no-op.
_checked_help: Date the whole list was last checked against a source, even if nothing was added. An empty list checked recently is fine; the email only nags when this is over 21 days old.

bonuses.note: Tiered: 15% under 50k, 25% for 50k-99,999, 35% for 100k+ per transfer; the minimum is recorded.
Applies to both Virgin Atlantic Flying Club and Virgin Red; cards_data.py lists Capital One's partner as Virgin Red.
10% on premium Citi cards (Strata Elite, Strata Premier, Prestige, AT&T Access More); select no-annual-fee cards get 770 per 1,000 instead.
